questions.question: Which of the following is true -
options: [A] Learning through one's mother tongue for a prolonged period leaves no time to learn other languages
[B] Development of proficiency in one language hinders development in other languages
[C] Solid grasp of one's mother tongue makes it difficult to learn a second language
[D] Proficiency in various languages is developed in an interdependent fashion
questions.answer: [D] Proficiency in various languages is developed in an interdependent fashion

questions.question: Census of India (2011) established that -
options: [A] Most people speak more than one language.
[B] Only 7% of the people can speak two languages.
[C] Only 7% of the people can speak in English, as and when needed.
[D] Most people can speak only their mother tongue.
questions.answer: [D] Most people can speak only their mother tongue.

questions.question: Which of the following statements does not feature in National Education Policy 2020?
options: [A] Young children learn the best through their mother tongues.
[B] Children should be taught in their mother tongues till at least grade 5.
[C] If children are taught through their mother tongues, they do not have adequate time in school to learn other languages.
[D] Learning how to read and write must begin in children's home languages.
questions.answer: [C] If children are taught through their mother tongues, they do not have adequate time in school to learn other languages.

questions.question: Making use of L1 in teaching-
options: [A] improves rote learning ability of children.
[B] creates difficulties for children to understand academic concepts.
[D] helps in better learning of all the subjects.
questions.answer: [D] helps in better learning of all the subjects.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a key principle of teaching a second language?
options: [A] Using L2 vocabulary for writing from the beginning years.
[B] To make L2 simple, comprehensible, interesting, and meaningful for children.
[C] Focusing on developing L2 based vocabulary from the beginning.
[D] Giving maximum exposure to students in L2.
questions.answer: [A] Using L2 vocabulary for writing from the beginning years.

questions.question: Kamala ji wants to teach Hindi to grade 2 students. Which of the following strategies should she use?
options: [A] Use of Hindi language as per the level of comprehension by students
[B] Practice and repetition of long and complex Hindi sentences
[C] Speaking only in Hindi language and not allowing children to speak in their home languages
[D] Maximum writing practice in Hindi given to students
questions.answer: [A] Use of Hindi language as per the level of comprehension by students

questions.question: What kind of language do we use in our day-to-day life?
Choose the incorrect statement -
options: [A] By learning through the mother tongue, children find it difficult to understand all the subjects.
[B] A solid foundation of first language skills helps a child in learning other languages.
[C] When children learn how to think in their own language, they can use those skills easily to other languages.
[D] In foundational grades, children must be taught the unfamiliar school language by taking help of their home languages.
questions.answer: [A] By learning through the mother tongue, children find it difficult to understand all the subjects.
